{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic League Finals''' took place in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], and was the final stage of the [[Galactic League/Legends|Galactic League]] [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] tournament. The [[Commenor Diamonds]] won the game and defeated the [[Kuat Artisans]].<ref name="TEGTW AC 8">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>
